A '''diamond mattock''' is the [[Diamond equipment|diamond]] [[mattock]], a shovel and hoe crafted from three [[diamond]]s and two sticks.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
It breaks shovel and hoe blocks at speed 8, one slower than the [[diamond shovel]] or [[diamond hoe]], with 2500 durability. Hoes in Matcha Flavoured also break wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|4}} damage at an attack speed of 3.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[diamond]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

It melts down into a diamond. It is a diamond hoe by item ID, so it can replace one in electrum and adamant smithing recipes.
